changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientdocuments AS SELECT pd.id, pd.patient_id, pd.country_id, pd.is_primary, pd.type, pd.number, pd.created_by, pd.created_date, pd.last_modified_by, pd.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_documents pd;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientdocuments TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientdocuments FROM report_user;
